verdict.rationale: Brex documents issuing vendor-specific cards for teams with per-transaction limits and approval flows, and its developer docs describe issuing virtual cards via the Team API and Pipedream, for example monthly-resetting stipend cards. One user also praised the 'dynamic credit card generator', which mildly corroborates on-demand card creation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that cards can be created instantly, purpose-scoped categories such as ad spend, in-depth first-party docs on scoping controls (merchant/category locks), and stronger independent hands-on corroboration.
